node.statement: Because e_S1 <= epsilon_*^r/C_rect, 0 <= epsilon_X <= e_S1, and C_rect >= 1, one has 0 <= epsilon_r = C_rect*epsilon_X <= epsilon_*^r. Since epsilon_*^r <= kappa_ch/(4*C_ch) and delta_* <= kappa_ch/(4*C_ch), C_ch*(epsilon_r + delta_*) <= kappa_ch/2 <= kappa_ch.
